ei.title: AI Hiring Tools and the Risk of Bias
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: There are a growing number of AI tools that companies use to screen job applicants. These automated systems decide which smaller set of applicants from a large pool will reach a human hiring manager. The AI tool analyzes video interviews for content, word choice, facial expressions, and so on, assigning each interviewee an "employability score," which is compared to those of other applicants. But the validity of these tools is dubious; in fact, there is no evidence that these scores accurately predict job performance. Critics worry that algorithms trained on limited data will be more likely to give higher employability scores to typical applicants who are more frequently represented in the current workforce and give lower scores to those who appear atypical because they are less frequently represented in the current workforce. The result would be to reinforce current demographic imbalances instead of building a diverse workforce. Put differently, these automated technological tools seem to be reproducing biased wallpaper in hiring decisions. And, in fact, the technology may even be magnifying bias in new ways.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① automated(자동화된) ② predict(예측하다) ③ higher(더 높은) ④ resolve(해결하다←reinforce 강화하다)
det.analysis:
① automated: 자동화된 시스템이 지원자를 선별 → 적절
② predict: 직무 성과를 예측한다는 증거가 없다 → 적절
③ higher: 전형적 지원자에게 더 높은 점수 → 적절
④ resolve: 인구통계적 불균형을 '해결'한다 → 원문은 불균형을 '강화(reinforce)'한다는 비판이므로 부적절 ←정답
det.tip: reinforce(강화하다) ↔ resolve(해결하다)

det.korean: ① screen(선별하다) ② higher(더 높은←lower 더 낮은) ③ biased(편향된) ④ magnifying(확대하는)
det.analysis:

④ magnifying: 편견을 확대하는 → 적절
det.tip: 비전형적(atypical) 지원자 → lower scores (더 낮은 점수)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
these automated technological tools seem to be reproducing ____ in hiring decisions → 채용 결정에서 재생산하는 것은 편향된 겉치레
① biased wallpaper: 편향된 벽지(겉치레) → 비유적 표현으로 편향 재생산의 핵심 ←정답

① accurately predict job performance: 직무 성과 예측 → 결과가 아닌 도구의 의도된 기능

② 외모 중시 → wallpaper를 문자 그대로 해석한 오답
③ 공정한 기준 → 글의 논점과 정반대
④ 투명성 → 본문에서 다루지 않는 내용
det.tip: wallpaper = 겉치레/표면적 장식 → 겉만 바뀌고 편향은 그대로

ch: 기존의 편향된 채용 관행을 겉모습만 바꿔 반복하고 있다.
채용 과정에서 지원자의 외모를 중시하고 있다.
인공지능이 새로운 공정한 기준을 만들어내고 있다.
기술 발전이 채용 시장의 투명성을 높이고 있다.

questions.passage: There are a growing number of AI tools that companies use to screen job applicants. These automated systems decide which smaller set of applicants from a large pool will reach a human hiring manager. The AI tool analyzes video interviews for content, word choice, facial expressions, and so on, assigning each interviewee an "employability score," which is compared to <u>those</u> of other applicants. But the validity of these tools is dubious; in fact, there is no evidence that these scores accurately predict job performance. Critics worry that algorithms trained on limited data will be more likely to give higher employability scores to typical applicants who are more frequently represented in the current workforce and give lower scores to those who appear atypical because they are less frequently represented in the current workforce. The result would be to reinforce current demographic imbalances instead of building a diverse workforce. Put differently, these automated technological tools seem to be reproducing biased wallpaper in hiring decisions. And, in fact, the technology may even be magnifying bias in new ways.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 those가 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
원문: assigning each interviewee an "employability score," which is compared to those of other applicants → those는 앞의 employability score(s)를 대신하는 지시대명사. 다른 지원자들의 '점수들'과 비교된다는 뜻.
① 고용가능성 점수들 → those = scores ←정답
② AI 도구들 → of other applicants와 어울리지 않음
③ 자동화 시스템들 → 비교 대상이 아님
④ 영상 면접들 → 비교 대상이 아님
det.tip: those = 앞에 나온 복수명사 대체 (scores)
